comparison.objective: Lift a bypass closet door into its track, seat it on the rib, and slide it into position.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-object lifting, track alignment, seating, sliding, and controlled release.
comparison.success_condition: Door is hung on the track, seated, slid left, and released. Exact seating and damage tolerances are unavailable.
comparison.reason: Track hanging tests load support and large-part seating; it does not test localized impact fracture, insert retention, or tiny-fragment recovery.
